name: guard-core
description: Guard Core security tools: validate fastapi-guard and guard-core configs, search the Guard documentation, resolve adapters across five languages, and run real attack payloads through the live detection engine.

interface.shortDescription: Validate Guard security configs and test attack payloads against the real detection engine.
interface.longDescription: Guard Core answers security questions about the Guard ecosystem from the libraries themselves instead of from memory. Validate a fastapi-guard, guard-core or guard-agent config and catch the unknown or misspelled keys pydantic silently ignores, look up what a setting does and what it defaults to, search and read the Guard documentation, run a request through the real penetration-detection engine to see whether it would be blocked and by which pattern, and resolve install and integration steps for any of the five-language, twenty-adapter Guard matrix. Config validation and payload checks run against the latest published releases hosted by the Guard Core platform.
defaultPrompt: Would fastapi-guard block this request: POST /login with body user=admin' OR 1=1--?
Is this SecurityConfig valid, and are any keys misspelled so they are silently ignored?
Which Guard package protects a Gin web app, and how do I wire its telemetry agent?
